# Boise Handyman Co - Full Reference

> Handyman service for Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley: small home repairs, installs, and maintenance. Drywall repair, interior and exterior painting, minor plumbing and electrical, carpentry and trim, mounting and assembly, fence, deck and gutter repair, caulking and punch-list work. Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, Caldwell. Phone (208) 477-1169.

## About

Boise Handyman Co is a locally owned handyman service for the Treasure Valley. We handle the small jobs that keep a home working: drywall repair and patching, interior and exterior painting touch-ups, minor plumbing and electrical repairs, carpentry and trim repair, door and window adjustment, TV, shelf and furniture mounting and assembly, fence, deck and gutter repair, caulking and weatherproofing, and general punch-list work. Every job gets a written quote before work starts, and most jobs are finished in one visit. Full remodels, additions, and anything that requires a general contractor or a licensed trade are out of scope and referred out.

- Business type: Handyman service (home repairs, installs, and maintenance)
- Service model: Upfront written quotes, one-trip fixes, hourly rate plus flat trip fee
- Contact: https://boisehandyman.co/contact
- Instant estimator: https://boisehandyman.co/estimate

## Service area

We serve the following Treasure Valley cities across Ada and Canyon County:

- Ada County: Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Kuna, Star
- Canyon County: Nampa, Middleton, Caldwell

Most handyman-scope repairs do not require a permit in Ada or Canyon County, and we flag the exceptions (structural, gas, major electrical or plumbing alterations) before work begins so the right licensed trade handles them.

## Services

- Drywall Repair & Patching: /services/drywall-repair - Holes, cracks, water-stained patches, and popcorn-ceiling repairs finished and blended to match.
- Interior & Exterior Painting: /services/painting-touch-ups - Room refreshes, trim and door repaints, and exterior touch-ups with proper prep and clean lines.
- Minor Plumbing Repairs: /services/plumbing-repairs - Faucets, toilets, garbage disposals, supply lines, and slow drains fixed or swapped in a single visit.
- Minor Electrical Repairs: /services/electrical-repairs - Outlets, switches, light fixtures, and ceiling fans replaced or repaired safely and to code.
- Carpentry & Trim Repair: /services/carpentry-trim-repair - Doors that stick, damaged trim and baseboard, stair rails, and small carpentry fixes done cleanly.
- Mounting & Assembly: /services/mounting-assembly - TVs, shelves, mirrors, and curtain rods mounted level and anchored right; furniture assembled fast.
- Fence, Deck & Gutter Repair: /services/fence-deck-gutter-repair - Leaning fence panels, loose deck boards and rails, gutter cleaning, and minor exterior repairs.
- Caulking & Home Maintenance: /services/home-maintenance - Caulking and weatherproofing, tile and grout touch-ups, and punch-list work knocked out in one trip.

## Common questions

- What does a handyman visit cost in Boise? Market rates in the Treasure Valley typically run $60 to $120 per hour. Our model is a flat trip fee plus an hourly rate, quoted as a written flat price before work starts, with a single small repair starting around $145.
- How fast can a repair be scheduled? Standard visits book at the next available slot, usually within the week; priority scheduling within two business days is available for an added fee. Most small repairs are finished in a single one-to-three-hour visit.
- Who supplies the materials? Either works. You can have parts on the counter when we arrive, or we pick them up and bill materials at cost with a supply-run line on the quote.
- What is out of scope? Full remodels, additions, structural work, repipes, panel or service upgrades, gas lines, and re-roofs. Those need a general contractor or a licensed trade, and we say so and refer out rather than take the job.
- Do small repairs need a permit? Most handyman-scope work in Ada and Canyon County does not. Structural changes and major electrical, plumbing, or mechanical alterations do, and we flag those before any work begins.

## RE-10 / Inspection Repairs

Boise Handyman Co also completes RE-10 and home inspection repairs for real estate agents, buyers and sellers across Boise and the Treasure Valley. An RE-10 is the Idaho inspection response form: after a home inspection the buyer requests specific repairs before closing. We review the RE-10 and inspection report, provide a written scope and pricing, coordinate access, complete the approved work across multiple trades, and supply photo documentation, invoices and receipts for the transaction file. Structural, foundation, mold and asbestos abatement, main electrical service, sewer and septic, HVAC replacement, gas lines and full roof replacement are coordinated to licensed specialists rather than performed in house. Inspection repair lists are exactly the small, defined jobs a handyman does every day, and we sequence them against a closing date that will not move. Details: https://boisehandyman.co/re-10-repairs-boise
